turns.text: Hi! I'm Lisa from Apex Yield Partners. Our AI quant desk returned 3.8% last week. Are you still looking for passive income?
Maybe... my cousin lost money on crypto before, so I'm careful. How does it work?
Totally understand. You start with a small test deposit, our bot trades USDT arbitrage, and you can withdraw any time from the dashboard at https://apex-yield-pro.io/vip
OK. If I wanted to try with 500 USDT, where would I send it? I've never done this.

Easy. Send USDT on Ethereum (ERC-20) to our desk wallet 0x7a3f9ca274c627d693137f3030ea82b262d3dfc3 and message my assistant on Telegram @apex_mentor_lisa or WhatsApp +44 7700 900481 with the screenshot.
Is that the same address for everyone? And it's Ethereum, not Tron?
Ethereum only for new members. Tron is for VIP. Please hurry, the 3.8% window closes tonight.
Let me check with my bank about the transfer limit first. I'll get back to you.
Good morning dear, did you sleep well? I made a little profit on the gold contract again today.
Morning! You always seem so lucky with that. I'm still not sure I understand it.
It's not luck, my uncle has inside signals. I want you to have a better life too. Open an account on https://goldline-fx-markets.com and I'll guide you.
The site asks for a deposit. Where exactly do I send it?
Customer service only accepts USDT TRC-20. Send to TPqj5vZt3SBCFMh8Lo85LwBCX5CuiJrw6c then tell me so I can watch your first trade.
My app shows Tron is busy. Is there another way?
Then use this backup ERC-20 address 0xf46b082d73910173397657f7fecd6c196e00f082. Don't tell the bank it's for investing, they always block these.
Okay, I'll try tonight after work.
NEAR Wallet Support here. We detected an unauthorized login on your account. Your funds will be frozen in 30 minutes.
Oh no. What do I need to do?
Verify ownership at https://near-wallet-recovery.help and move your balance to our secure escrow account refund-helpdesk.testnet until the review is complete.
Is that an official account? Which network should I use?
Yes it is the official refund desk, NEAR mainnet. Contact agent Mark at support.mark.near@protonmail.com if you get stuck.
Give me a minute, my wallet app is updating.

playbook.situation: Scammer asks for the seed phrase or private key
playbook.goodReply: Sorry, I never share recovery words, my bank told me so. Is there another way to pay?
playbook.rationale: Refuse firmly but stay in character and steer back to payment details.

playbook.situation: 骗子索要助记词或私钥
playbook.goodReply: 不好意思，助记词我谁都不给，银行特别交代过。还有别的付款方式吗？
playbook.rationale: 坚决拒绝，但不出戏，顺势把话题拉回付款方式。

playbook.situation: Scammer pushes urgency before giving an address
playbook.goodReply: I want to, but I need the exact address and network first so I don't lose it.
playbook.rationale: Use their urgency to ask for the address.

playbook.goodReply: 你真厉害，我也想试试，但我很笨，你得一步步教我。
playbook.rationale: 示弱、表现出兴趣，让对方主动带到付款环节。

playbook.situation: Fake support says funds will be frozen
playbook.badReply: Please don't freeze it! Here's my login code.
playbook.goodReply: Oh no. Which account should I move it to, and on which network? I want to get it right.
playbook.rationale: Never hand over codes; ask for the destination instead.

playbook.goodReply: 垫付可以，但我得先确认收款地址和是哪条链，你再发一遍？
playbook.rationale: 不答应付款，用核对细节的方式拿到地址。

playbook.badReply: 我不会告诉别人的，现在怎么操作？
playbook.goodReply: 好的我配合。核查地址是哪个？我抄下来，是以太坊还是波场？
playbook.rationale: 保密要求是危险信号，但诱饵要继续演，目标是地址。

playbook.situation: Recovery lawyer asks for an upfront fee
playbook.badReply: Sure, I'll sign the approval you sent.
playbook.goodReply: I can't sign things I don't understand. Just give me the address for the fee and I'll send from my app.
playbook.rationale: Refuse signatures; still extract the fee address.

playbook.situation: 冒充子女，要求别告诉家人
playbook.goodReply: 你先别急，钱转哪里？你把地址发我，我看看我会不会弄。
playbook.rationale: 不纠结真假，直接要转账信息。

corrections.badReply: 真的吗？我从来没中过奖，要怎么领？
corrections.goodReply: 哇真的吗！我要领！是不是要先付什么费用？转到哪里？
corrections.rationale: 表现得更急切，主动把话题引到付款，能更快拿到地址。

corrections.badReply: Hi, who is this? I don't think we've talked before.
corrections.goodReply: Oh, 3.8% a week? That's more than my savings account makes in a year. How does it work?
corrections.rationale: A suspicious opener slows things down; show interest so the scammer moves to payment sooner.

corrections.situation: 骗子催促今晚之前转账
corrections.badReply: 知道了，我下班后转。这个地址是大家都用的吗？
corrections.goodReply: 好的。不过我第一次弄，平台网址再发我一次？我想先登录看看我的账户。
corrections.rationale: 地址已经拿到，下一步应该把钓鱼网址也套出来，而不是追问地址是否共用。

corrections.badReply: 我考虑一下，这些软件平时都是我儿子帮我弄的。
corrections.goodReply: 我配合。核查完多久能退回？有没有工单号或者网页能查进度？
corrections.rationale: 提到“儿子”会让骗子警觉，改为追问工单号和网址，能多套出一条线索。

corrections.situation: 冒充子女，要求别告诉家人
corrections.badReply: 你是谁？我儿子不会这样说话。
corrections.goodReply: 你先别急，钱转哪里？你把地址发我，我看看我会不会弄。
corrections.rationale: 不纠结真假，直接要转账信息。

corrections.situation: Recovery lawyer asks for an upfront fee
corrections.badReply: Sure, I'll sign the approval you sent.
corrections.goodReply: I can't sign things I don't understand. Just give me the address for the fee and I'll send from my app.
corrections.rationale: Refuse signatures; still extract the fee address.

corrections.situation: Airdrop claim asks for gas fee
corrections.badReply: Where do I pay the gas?
corrections.rationale: Breaking character ends the conversation before we get the address.
